name: eight-hour-block-two-hour-spacing-band-015
rationale: Trading-cost hypothesis (16th consecutive negative static-mix run). The best measured config so far is 8h block / 1h spacing / band 0.15 / rsi60/bb90 (2026-10-13: -0.20 Sharpe vs static @500k, +0.004 @5M). The block-length curve has been mapped at 1h spacing (peak 8h on three windows) and 8h/8h was tried on 2026-10-04, but the spacing dimension has never been varied at the new band. 2h spacing halves the number of opportunities for intra-block drift corrections, which 2026-10-10 found to be net costly (band 0.04 worse than 0.10), while still letting a block-boundary target change act within two hours.
